method: The same assistant role-plays planner and reviewer, reading actual API outputs and the synthetic quote catalog. These are authored decisions, not independent agent-model or blind benchmark outputs.

planner.reason: Morning flights, comfortable baggage allowance, step-free hotel, calm beach time and local food match the visible brief. This is a draft only. Party size, maximum walking, daily activity limit and boating restrictions need an evidence check before approval.

reviewer.decision: Approve the draft under the original INR 90000 cap only after the additional memory checks. Limit the two planned activities to separate days and retain arrival/rest time.
reviewer.memory_problem: The default context omitted restrictions that the reviewer had to retrieve manually. The approval depends on those extra calls, not on the ready flag alone.
